summary: Full architectural audit completed across backend modular monolith and frontend Next.js App Router. Zero circular imports, consistent composite tenant scoping across all repository queries, strict anti-injection prompt boundary framing, and validated Next.js Turbopack build with 0 TypeScript errors. Minor findings documented for post-M05 lifecycle automation.

criteria_results.separation_of_concerns: PASS — Strict layering: API routers -> Dependencies -> Repositories/Services -> Models
criteria_results.tenant_isolation_architecture: PASS — Composite keys, TenantContext dependency, and explicit WHERE tenant_id scoping on all relational queries
criteria_results.provider_abstraction: PASS — LLMProvider abstract base with deterministic registry and SSRF protection
criteria_results.frontend_architecture: PASS — Next.js 16.4.5 App Router with clear Client/Server boundary, token injection, and SSE stream parsing
criteria_results.dependency_hygiene: PASS — Modern pinned dependencies (Python 3.12+, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, Next.js 16.4.5, React 19)
